claim_boundary: Operational transparency only; not scientific evidence. Scheduling contention can affect runtime but, absent an OOM/technical error, does not change the frozen deterministic model/environment computation.
handling_rule: No protocol change. If a CUDA OOM is emitted, use the already-frozen same-index retry rule; never skip/replace a family. Otherwise continue unchanged.
incident: A non-study Qwen3 persistent-session VRAM smoke was inadvertently launched on the same RTX3050 while the canonical dev run was live. It was cancelled immediately after model-load progress was observed, before any synthetic score/result was emitted.
